Overview

Cascais is a city in Lisboa with a population of 214,124. A glamorous coastal town near Lisbon, known for its beaches, marina, and upscale lifestyle. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
